summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the detailed packet of an index becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: Whether Pocketful streams indices with the detailed layout, and with what in the trade fields, needs a live check.

deviations.reason: Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds and the web passes the seconds on as ltt; the desktop sends epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time (decisions 2026-11-09: ltt in seconds -> ms, a web defect, wrong unit).

The web sends zero; the docs say leave it out (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, "Field availability": a field the stream does not carry is not invented as zero; lead decision 2026-11-09). An index has no trades, book or open interest: Pocketful's index packet fills these with zeros, which the web passes on; the desktop's index frame leaves them out.
